program.name: From Representation to Control
program.thesis: Reasoning depends not only on what a representation entails, but on what it constructs as recoverable, identifiable, accessible, and behaviorally controlling.

papers.title: LP4FM Source Arbitration
papers.stop_condition: Do not extend to a universal controller, item-level law, or broad causal mechanism.
papers.next_action: Preserve the submitted manuscript and evidence boundary.

papers.title: When Context Changes the Rule
dependencies: independent worlds, prompts, scorer and confirmation split
papers.stop_condition: No native rule-swap effect means pivot to fact updating or policy-identifiability boundary.
papers.next_action: Freeze policy family and run a validity-screened paired rule-swap pilot.

papers.title: Training-Induced Composition Laws
papers.stop_condition: No stage-specific or controlled effect means retain a checkpoint boundary only.
papers.next_action: Wait for A1 pilot decision and checkpoint-access audit.

papers.title: Formal Capability Certificates
papers.object: verifiable formal capability without acceptance bias
gates: anti-shortcut result beyond a known benchmark
safe separation of theorem and empirical claim
papers.stop_condition: Known task difficulty without a new certificate or anti-shortcut protocol is not a standalone paper.
papers.next_action: Audit one restricted object before building a Type-Meaning Cube.

papers.title: Where Chains of Thought Choose
gates: focused scaffold selectively helps high-kappa items
papers.stop_condition: If kappa does not beat chain length, abandon a universal choice-complexity law.
papers.next_action: Run a small step-matched kappa pilot.

papers.title: Classically Equivalent, Dynamically Distinct
papers.stop_condition: If truth-conditional predictors dominate, report that boundary rather than forcing a DRT account.
papers.next_action: Build the minimal accessibility contrast and validity protocol.

papers.title: Schemas Are Types
papers.stop_condition: No propositional-to-type gain means explicitization may be sufficient.
papers.next_action: Defer full experiment until B1 and equivalence tooling stabilize.

papers.title: Constructed, Not Entailed
dependencies: at least two independently validated B1-B3 laws
papers.next_action: Do not execute before component evidence exists.

papers.title: Same Semantics, Different Computations
papers.stop_condition: No token-matched effect means restrict claims to natural-format sensitivity.

papers.title: Linguistic Relativity of Relational Control
dependencies: stable A1 identification and control measures
papers.stop_condition: Effects explained by competence, tokenization, or global calibration stop the causal-relativity branch.
papers.next_action: Use multilinguality only as external generalization until A1 stabilizes.

papers.title: Controlled Linguistic Experience
papers.stop_condition: Training-format-only gains do not support reasoning transfer.
papers.next_action: Design only after D1 survives confound audit.

papers.title: When Is a Controller Identifiable?
papers.stop_condition: Probe-only or task-local effects remain supporting diagnostics.

papers.title: Artificial Language Learning in Humans and LLMs
papers.stop_condition: Do not spend human-study budget before the model treatment effect stabilizes.

papers.title: Machine-Designed Reasoning Languages
gates: semantic equivalence and no answer leakage
papers.stop_condition: If measures cannot predict before evaluation, the result is prompt optimization rather than representation synthesis.

next_18_months.action: Run the A1 paired rule-swap validity pilot
Run the B1 step-matched kappa pilot
Run the C1 token-matched Program-DAG pilot
Build shared provenance and equivalence tooling only as demanded by passed gates
